compatibility_status: import_and_five_finger_initialization_verified; live dynamic task and controls being tested independently
compatibility_api: from sharpa_tacmap_compat import enable_compat; enable_compat() after SimulationApp startup and before SharpaTacmap import
scope: New RayCaster and Warp implementation stay under private _sharpa_isaaclab232 namespace.
Only missing isaaclab sim transform, mesh, dynamic ray and MultiMesh APIs are added to the process.
No system IsaacLab source file or official Sharpa file edited.
conditions_and_limits: Targets must be exact body-local geometry; current TacmapRaySurface children have identity transform under the live rigid-body targets. Nonzero target child offsets are avoided due upstream offset algebra.
Sensor attaches to actual PhysX distal rigid body and uses URDF distal-to-elastomer offset in world camera convention; no non-rigid USD headless pose fallback used in the task.
XformPrimView adapter only bridges constructor vocabulary to Sim5 XFormPrim. Dynamic non-physics USD tracking is not claimed.
Official config inherits MultiMeshRayCaster class_type; instantiate SharpaTacmap(cfg) explicitly.

Official constructor initializes its base twice. Source is preserved; recording must check one frame increment per requested update. Lifecycle cache cleanup in long-lived repeated sensor creation is not validated.
Official surface maps use millimetres; correction_scale=.001; TH uses thumb files, other four use 4F_*_origin files, for the right hand.
Offset tuples must contain Python float, not numpy.float64, to preserve upstream default float32 math.
resolution_step=1 yields 240x240 and 9x9 Gaussian; step3 also gives valid odd kernel; steps2/4 produce invalid even kernels in upstream torchvision code.
Zero point/normal cells are invalid surface samples. Keep raw output intact; validity mask is metadata.
Official output is uint8 after nonlinear quantization then GaussianBlur. Values are not force, pressure, or unfiltered linear millimetres.
No FEM/material stiffness solve is introduced; original rigid-body physics and contact offsets are unmodified.
TH/4F public maps and current W01 elastomer geometry can differ; report physical-force channels separately from official geometry TacMap.
